_comment: Register these as webhook tools on your Telnyx AI Assistant. Replace <PROJECT_REF> with your Supabase project ref, and set header x-carecall-secret to the same value as the TOOL_WEBHOOK_SECRET function secret. Telnyx automatically includes call_control_id in tool webhook payloads.

tools.name: verify_patient
tools.description: Verify the patient's identity by comparing their stated date of birth against the record on file. Returns match (boolean), locked (boolean — if true, end the call and do not proceed), and remaining_attempts.

stated_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth the patient stated, normalized to YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_appointment_slots
tools.description: Get real availability for the patient's provider. Use granularity 'days' to get up to 3 available days, then granularity 'times' with on_date to get up to 3 concrete times for the chosen day. Only offer options returned by this tool.

on_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, required when granularity is 'times' and a day was chosen

from_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest date to search from (optional)

days.description: How many days ahead to search, default 14

tools.name: create_appointment
tools.description: Book the appointment slot the patient explicitly confirmed. Pass the exact slot_start ISO timestamp returned by get_appointment_slots. Returns booked:true with a spoken confirmation, or reason 'slot_taken' if it was just filled.

slot_start.description: Exact ISO 8601 slot_start value from get_appointment_slots

tools.name: mark_outcome
tools.description: Record the outcome of the call when no appointment is booked: declined, callback_requested, wrong_number, or needs_human (escalation).

callback_after.description: ISO timestamp after which to retry, for callback_requested

note.description: Short note for staff, e.g. what the patient needs
